question.html:
Monochromatic light is incident on eight slits and produces a diffraction pattern on a screen. Then the number of slits is halved while the slit width and the distance between the slits remain the same. Which of the following statements are correct about the new pattern on the screen?

I. There is an increase in the width of the primary maxima.

II. The distance between the primary maxima is unchanged.

III. There is an increase in the intensity of the primary maxima. 

  1. I and II only
  2. I and III only
  3. II and III only
  4. I, II and III
